infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FlowNest uses the camera to capture property, collection, and cheque images for collection records and verification purposes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FlowNest accesses your photo library so users can upload property, collection, and cheque images as attachments in collection entries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: FlowNest saves captured images to your photo library when users choose to store collection-related images.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app uses the microphone for voice input.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: This app uses speech recognition to convert voice into text.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to log in quickly.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera to scan QR codes and capture images for collection records.
